concept.hr: Zvučni glasovi su crte harmonika pod formantima, bezvučni su šum
concept.en: Voiced sounds are harmonic lines under formants; unvoiced sounds are noise

summary.hr: Amplitudni spektar samoglasnika a, i, u i bezvučnog „s“: harmonici osnovne frekvencije, formanti, šum i pojas 300–2700 Hz radiouređaja; uz to mikrofon uživo.
summary.en: The amplitude spectrum of the vowels a, i, u and the unvoiced "s": harmonics of f0, formants, noise and a radio's 300–2700 Hz band; plus a live microphone.

what.hr: Aplet spektrum_sprachsignale.html (spektar mikrofona uživo, najjača frekvencija) i tekst o govornom signalu (50ohm.de, odjeljak sprachsignale)
what.en: The applet spektrum_sprachsignale.html (the live microphone spectrum, the strongest frequency) and the text on the speech signal (50ohm.de, section sprachsignale)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan kao SVG umjesto Chart.js, preveden na engleski, dodani model glasa (samoglasnici i „s“), ovojnica s formantima, pojas 300–2700 Hz i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn as SVG instead of Chart.js, translated into English, a voice model (vowels and "s"), the envelope with formants, the 300–2700 Hz band and presets added
